about: « Mémoire partagée », per agent, at the bottom of its page, and the defaults for an agent on an outside model (Alex 23/11: « on construit et on met un pop-up explicatif quand c'est un modèle externe : la mémoire partagée et le Carnet sont désactivés par défaut pour un modèle connecté »; passation-pro briefs/status-shared-memory.md). The bridge keeps it (bridge-rs/src/agent_shared_memory.rs, outside_model.rs, shared_memory.rs) and tells it in the agent's settings; the apps draw it (AgentPageView.swift, AgentPageScreen.kt). Read by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_shared_memory_setting.py (the bridge's answers), HermesKit AgentSharedMemoryTests and Android AgentSharedMemoryTest (what the apps read and draw). Additions only: an app 1.0 ignores `shared_memory` and draws nothing; the bridge applies the defaults and the cleaning all the same.

routes.settings: GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/settings: + `shared_memory: {on, circle, outside: {provider, label, since} | null}`; absent for an agent without the setting (other people talk to it: the family's agent, a project agent, an agent shared with a relative or linked with another household's agents; set up by hand; a profile of a Hermes the person brought). `on`: its switch; `circle`: it receives the common memory now (its switch on and its Carnet on); `outside.since`: when the protection applied (the pop-up is shown again after a new one). `outside.provider` « unknown »: a model the bridge cannot tell (protected as outside), `label` then says so in the person's language. Its presence is the capability: the apps draw the switch only then.
routes.put: PUT /v1/agents/{agent_id}/shared-memory {on} → {id, on}. 404: not an agent of this place. 409 {"detail": "others_facing"}: an agent other people talk to. 400 {"detail": "by_hand"}: set up by hand, or a brought Hermes' profile. 422: no `on`, or not a boolean.
routes.file: <data>/agent_shared_memory.json (0600): {"off": [agent], "outside": {agent: {provider, label, at, off: ["shared_memory" | "notebook"]}}}. An agent absent from `off` has it on, unless it is on an outside model the bridge has not seen yet.
routes.off: Out of the shared memory's circle; what it received from the common list taken out of its USER.md (the keys the bridge wrote there; for what it received before 23/11, the common entries learnt by someone else and what was in the list once), what it wrote itself kept; the handovers another agent left in its MEMORY.md (« ↪ Passé par … ») taken out too; memories/.prompt-day.json removed; `memory.user_profile_enabled: false` in its profile's config.yaml (a `false` the person wrote stays); no Carnet news; no handover into its MEMORY.md; no imported facts in its USER.md; each of its conversations goes on in a new Hermes session (the same thread: the apps keep showing what was said; Hermes no longer replays the history); its conversations' prompts refreshed. The same cleaning when it leaves the circle for any other reason (its Carnet off, shared with a relative).
routes.outside: « Modèle extérieur »: one of the models of its profile's config.yaml (else the hub's) — `model`, `fallback_model`, `fallback_providers`, `auxiliary.*`, `delegation`, `smart_model_routing` — is neither the person's own (an address of this machine, the local network, their Tailscale network; Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM named without an address, but never an Ollama `…:cloud` model) nor one of our European providers (exactly eurouter.ai or mistral.ai); a provider Hermes knows by name (OpenAI, Anthropic…) counts whatever address is beside it; `custom` without its address follows the profile's CUSTOM_BASE_URL / OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, else OpenRouter. A model the bridge cannot tell is protected as outside when nothing is noted yet. Then, once per provider: shared memory, Carnet, Health off and the agent « à l'écart » of the other agents (rules.rs `aside`), its conversations in new sessions; at its creation (a model of the catalogue too), before a model route writes an outside model, at the bridge's start and every 15 s. Its in-conversation asks for the Carnet and Health are not offered, nor « Aussi pour… » for it, nor an older card's « Oui ». The person may turn each back on (the apps ask first for the shared memory and the Carnet); back on a model that is not outside, what the bridge had turned off and the person never touched comes back on. Agents other people talk to get the same protection (no shared memory setting).

settings.name: own_agent_default
settings.about: One of the person's own agents on our provider: on.

settings.name: outside_default
settings.about: Created on an outside model (a hub on ChatGPT through Codex): both off by default.

settings.name: outside_on_knowingly
settings.about: Turned back on by the person, knowingly: stays on.

settings.name: project_agent
settings.about: An agent other people talk to: no `shared_memory` at all.

rules.apostrophes: The texts are written with the apps' typographic apostrophe (’).
rules.where: At the bottom of the agent's page, right after « Initiative »: a small heading, one switch, one grey line under it. Nothing else on the page moves.
rules.hidden: No `shared_memory` in the settings (an app 1.1 on an older bridge, an agent without the setting): nothing drawn, not even the heading.
rules.line: The grey line says what the state does: `line_on` / `line_off`; on but out of the circle (its Carnet off): `line_on_carnet_off`; for an agent on an outside model, `line_outside_on` (in the circle) / `line_outside_off` with {provider} = `outside.label`.
rules.tap: Turning it off: at once, PUT {on: false}. Turning it on for an agent on an outside model: first `confirm_title` / `confirm_text` with `confirm_on` and `confirm_cancel`; only `confirm_on` sends PUT {on: true}. Otherwise at once. The answer's `on` is kept; a failure puts the previous state back with the app's usual error line.
rules.popup: Once per agent, provider and protection (`outside.provider`, `outside.since`), on this phone: when the app reads the settings of an agent with `outside` and `on` false (opening its page or its conversation, its tools), an alert `popup_title` / `popup_text`, {agent} = its name and {provider} = `outside.label`, one button `popup_ok`. Never in the demo, never for an agent whose shared memory is on.
rules.demo: The demo keeps the switch on the phone (on for every agent, none on an outside model).
rules.carnet: Turning the Carnet on (« Applis et outils ») for an agent with `outside`: first `carnet_confirm_title` / `carnet_confirm_text`, `confirm_on` / `confirm_cancel`; only `confirm_on` turns it on.

en.title: Shared memory

en.line_off: It doesn’t get what your other agents know about you.

To protect your privacy, its shared memory, the Notebook, Health and its exchanges with your other agents (messages, files and discussions) are off, and its conversations start afresh: it no longer reads what was said there before. You can turn each back on from its page.
en.known_off: Shared memory off: it doesn’t get what your other agents know about you.
en.line_on_carnet_off: Its Notebook is off: it doesn’t get what your other agents know about you.

de.line_off: Er bekommt nicht, was deine anderen Agenten über dich wissen.

de.line_outside_off: Externes Modell ({provider}): Was deine Agenten über dich wissen, bekommt er nicht.
de.confirm_text: {agent} nutzt ein externes Modell ({provider}). Was deine Agenten über dich wissen, wird ihm geschickt.
de.popup_text: {agent} nutzt ein externes Modell ({provider}).
